opening.argument: The speakers present OneCoin as a financial opportunity built around recruitment, not as neutral cryptocurrency commentary. They highlight a claimed compensation outcome of "$40,000 a week" while describing participation in terms of bringing people and building a large team. Those statements place recruitment-based earnings at the center of the solicitation. The invitation is also direct: viewers are told to click a link and join nightly webinars, reinforcing that the message seeks participation in the promoted opportunity rather than merely discussing digital currency.
